settingsCard.hint: Paste a new System User token from Meta Business when the old one expires or is replaced.

banner.tokenBody: The access token has expired or was replaced. Shop owners are not getting Bills, Receipts or Notes until it is fixed.
banner.paymentBody: The WhatsApp account has a payment problem. Shop owners are not getting Bills, Receipts or Notes until it is fixed in Meta Business.

form.label: New access token
form.placeholder: Paste the token from Meta Business
form.hint: Motake checks it with Meta first. A refused token never replaces the current one.
form.saved: Meta accepted it. New messages go out again.
form.savedWaiting: Meta accepted it. {count} messages are still waiting; send them with the button below.

send.blockedInvalid: Fix the access token first. Meta refuses the current one, so nothing can be sent.

send.confirmBody: They go to shop owners with the same figures and PDFs they had when they were created. Each goes out once; anything already sent or replaced by a newer Bill is skipped.

refusals.token_invalid: Meta says this token is invalid or expired. The current token is unchanged. Copy a fresh token and try again.
refusals.token_check_unavailable: Couldn't reach Meta to check the token. Try again.
refusals.token_not_working: WhatsApp messages are paused because the access token is not working. Save a working token first.
refusals.notification_unavailable: Couldn't do that right now. Try again in a minute.

reason.supersededNewer: Dropped: a newer Bill version was made before this went out.

failure.auth_error: WhatsApp is paused: the access token stopped working.
failure.payment_error: WhatsApp is paused: payment problem on the WhatsApp account.
failure.opted_out_or_blocked: The shop blocked Motake on WhatsApp or turned off business messages.
failure.rate_limited: Too many messages at once. WhatsApp will try again.
failure.ambiguous: WhatsApp did not confirm whether it went out.

block.held: Goes out by itself once WhatsApp is fixed.
block.billCancelled: The Bill is cancelled. Its Bill messages are not sent again.
block.olderBill: Older Bill version. Use Send latest Bill.
block.latestCancelled: This Bill is cancelled. Nothing more is sent for it.

latest.done: Sent the latest Bill with its PDF and today's Balance.
